chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Let one of you adorn himself on the day of Friday by washing, applying perfume, combing his beard, and wearing the cleanest of his clothes. Let him prepare for Friday, and let tranquility and dignity be upon him during that day. Let him perform good worship of his Lord, and let him do good as much as he is able, for Allah looks upon the people of the earth to multiply the good deeds.'

key_terms.لِيُحْسِنْ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ: To perform good worship of his Lord

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended acts of preparation and etiquette for Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) linking physical purification (ghusl, perfume, grooming) with spiritual tranquility (sakina), reflecting the Shia emphasis on Friday as a day of communal and individual spiritual renewal. This preparation is not merely aesthetic but a form of worship that invites divine attention, as Allah surveys the earth to multiply rewards for the faithful.
